verdict.rationale: Sketch ships its own programmatic surfaces: an official JavaScript API with an escape hatch to the internal API, the sketchtool CLI, a sketch:// URL scheme, an open JSON file format, and a built-in MCP server. Together these cover much of the Mac app's design functionality, but nothing documents that they match everything the UI can do. Workspace and web-app features have no evidenced API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a documented web/Workspace API (sharing, comments, starred versions, folders, permissions), an OpenAPI/REST spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: An official vanilla JavaScript API, fully supported between releases. Browse all classes and methods, or drop down to the internal API when needed.
Create assets with a single command with the Sketch command-line interface `sketchtool`.
Sketch includes a built-in MCP Server, a lightweight local-only web server that lets AI clients like ChatGPT or Claude interact directly with Sketch.
Integrate Sketch into your workflows with the `sketch://` URL scheme.
